thread:
Maya SRE: paging: NLB in euc2 is seeing mass TCP RSTs from targets, ~30% of ingress connections failing. seeing spike in 5xx and connection reset logs. @Leo please take.

incident-bot: incident created (INC-2026-1123) — severity: high — oncall: Leo (oncall)

Leo (oncall): I'm on it, gathering metrics. Can someone confirm if this is limited to euc2 or cross-region?

Olivia - NetEng: Net telemetry shows euc2b ASG heartbeats dropping and multiple target deregistration events. Route53 health checks still green but origin ALB reports increased 502/503. Also seeing NAT gateway connection churn.

Harry - Infra: I'm checking NLB target health and target group metrics. Early signal: conntrack table on ingress nodes in euc2c is near exhaustion. Might be short L4 connection spikes. Increasing conntrack won't fix root cause but may buy time.

Leo (oncall): For mitigation, let's do a regional weight shift to euc3 while we investigate. Olivia, can you lower euc2 LB weight to 0.6 and bump euc3 to 1.4?

Olivia - NetEng: doing weight change via traffic-controller now. command: `trafficctl set-weight --region euc2 --weight 0.6 && trafficctl set-weight --region euc3 --weight 1.4`

deploy-bot: traffic-controller: weights applied, propagation in progress (~30s).

Maya SRE: Observability: frontend p50 latency unchanged, p95 dropping in euc2 but overall error rate is improving. Customer impact: several VIPs reported intermittent 502s for write-heavy workloads; estimated 5% of customer requests affected in last 10m.

Priya (Customer Success): Notifying top-tier customers that we are mitigating and will follow up. Can we get ETA for full resolution?

Harry - Infra: Immediate mitigation: increasing conntrack and lowering keepalive timeout on ingress nodes to free slots. Applying sysctl: `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=2500000` and `net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout=30`. Rolling these changes to euc2 ingress ASG now.

Leo (oncall): Do a controlled restart of the ingress-controller DaemonSet pods after sysctl change to ensure they pick up kernel settings. Use gradual rollout to avoid mass reconnects.

Olivia - NetEng: Also seeing a Route53 cache inconsistency between regions — some clients still hitting euc2 internal endpoints. We'll shorten TTL to 30s to speed the shift.

incident-bot: paging update: mitigation in progress — conntrack configs applied (started), weights adjusted, TTL lowered.

Maya SRE: We're seeing error rate drop to ~1.2% from 5% after weight shift and kernel changes. Still seeing sporadic RSTs from a subset of hosts; isolating them now.

Harry - Infra: Found 3 nodes in euc2c with NIC resets — kernel logs show firmware timeout, opening ticket with cloud provider. Cordon and drain for replacement.

Olivia - NetEng: After cordon & drain, target churn decreased significantly. Traffic stable in euc3; continue to monitor for 30m then plan full failback.

Leo (oncall): Next steps: keep weights shifted for 30m, monitor SLOs. If stable, we'll slowly failback by percentage and leave new conntrack limits for 24h. Prep RCA runbook.

Priya (Customer Success): Notified customers, will send an update in 15 minutes. Any impact to Dedicated customers with pinned regions? Need a note.

Maya SRE: Dedicated customers pinned to euc2: two have early errors; send workaround: manual routing to alternative region (we'll assist). Logging follow-up.

Olivia - NetEng: cloud provider ticket created: CP-987654 — NIC firmware flaps causing resets on host NICs. ETA unknown. We asked for emergency replacement.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. assigned owners: Leo (oncall) / Harry (Infra) / Olivia (NetEng). Please escalate if errors rise.

Leo (oncall): Handoff to next oncall at 2278884700 UTC. @Maya I'll leave the postmortem notes and action items.

Maya SRE: Adding action items: 1) increase conntrack default cluster-wide, 2) increase LB backend health probe sensitivity, 3) automated swap to warm spare region on NIC failure, 4) notify ops for firmware update schedule. Will draft RCA.

Priya (Customer Success): Thanks team. I'll post customer-facing update and follow up with dedicated customer owners.

Leo (oncall): Closing the page for now, monitoring 30m before full closure. Thanks all :thumbsup:
